requirement.title: Rejection of same-account transfers
requirement.statement: A transfer where source and destination accounts are the same must be rejected, leaving balances unchanged and creating no transaction record.
requirement.source_quote: The source and destination must be different accounts. Same-account transfers must be rejected with a clear explanation and must not alter balances or create a transaction.

assertions.description: Submitting a transfer with identical source and destination accounts triggers a rejection
Balances of the selected account remain unchanged before and after the rejected attempt
No new transaction record is added to transaction history

verdicts.title: Rejection of transfer exceeding available balance

requirement.title: Rejection of transfer exceeding available balance
requirement.statement: If the transfer amount exceeds the source account's available balance, the transfer must be rejected, both balances must remain unchanged, and no completed transfer must appear in history.
requirement.source_quote: The amount must not exceed the source account's available balance. If funds are insufficient, the transfer must be rejected, both balances must remain unchanged, and no completed transfer must appear in history.

assertions.description: Transfer is rejected when amount is greater than source available balance
Source and destination balances remain identical to pre-transfer state
No completed transfer record appears in transaction history

requirement.title: Filter history by date range
requirement.statement: The user can filter transaction history by date range, such that every displayed row falls within the specified date range, every matching record in unfiltered history is displayed, and the result is non-empty when matches exist.
requirement.source_quote: The user can filter history by account, transaction type, status, and date range. When filters are applied, every displayed row must satisfy all selected filters.

assertions.description: All displayed rows have date timestamps falling within the specified date range
All transactions in unfiltered history within the specified date range are shown
Filtered history is not empty when matching transactions exist in the dataset

requirement.title: Inclusive date boundary filtering
requirement.statement: Date range filtering is inclusive of start and end dates; transactions occurring on either boundary date are included in the results when matching other filters.
requirement.source_quote: The start and end dates are inclusive. A transaction occurring on either boundary date must be included when it matches the other filters.
